data.content_ref: inline:The single-edge fragility profile of SRC_004 reduces to the threshold-placement rule of SRC_010: a node is fragile iff deleting some attack edge changes the set of τ-exceeding root attacks, equivalently the node's minimum τ-margin across root-incident edges is zero. Refuted if there is an IN node whose fragility status changes under single-edge deletion while all τ-margins for root edges remain unchanged.
